name: Plumber
duties: General plumbing works including installation, maintenance, and repair of pipes, fittings, and fixtures.
Ensuring proper water supply and drainage systems according to project requirements.
requirements: Must be skilled and experienced in Plumbing work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Physical fitness and willingness to work hard.
Ability to follow safety guidelines and instructions at work.

name: Mason
duties: Lay bricks, concrete blocks, and stones.
Carry out plastering, concrete pouring, foundation work, and general masonry construction.
requirements: Must be skilled and experienced in Masonry work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Physical strength and ability to work on heavy construction structures.

name: Plasterman
duties: Mix and apply plaster, mortar, or cement coats to interior and exterior walls and ceilings.
Achieve smooth or textured finishes as required.
requirements: Must be skilled and experienced in Plastering work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Good physical condition and endurance for continuous plastering work.

name: Building Painter
duties: Prepare surfaces (cleaning, scraping, sanding, filling).
Prime and apply paint or protective coatings to buildings and structures.
requirements: Must be skilled and experienced in Painting work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Knowledge of paint mixing, surface preparation, and coating techniques.

name: Tile Layer
duties: Prepare floors and walls and lay ceramic, porcelain, and stone tiles true to line and level.
Cut tiles to fit, apply adhesive and grout, and finish joints neatly.
requirements: Must be skilled and experienced in Tiling work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Ability to read measurements and keep lines, levels, and patterns accurate.

name: Welder
duties: Weld, cut, and join steel and metal parts for structures, frames, and pipes.
Read drawings and check welds for strength and quality.
requirements: Must be skilled and experienced in Welding work (arc, MIG, or gas).
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Knowledge of welding safety and use of protective equipment.

name: Carpenter
duties: Build, install, and repair formwork, shuttering, roofs, and timber structures on construction sites.
Measure, cut, and fix wood and boards according to drawings.
requirements: Must be skilled and experienced in Carpentry work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Ability to use hand and power tools safely.

name: Joiner
duties: Cut, shape, and join fine timber/wood components.
Make doors, windows, cabinets, stairs, and detailed interior fittings.
requirements: Proven experience and skill in Joinery and precision wood work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Proficiency in handling specialized woodworking tools and machinery.

name: Foreman
duties: Supervise and guide a team of workers on the construction site.
Plan daily work, check quality and progress, and make sure safety rules are followed.
requirements: Proven experience as a Foreman or Supervisor in construction work.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Leadership skills and basic English for communication with management.

name: Agriculture Worker
duties: Planting, watering, weeding, and harvesting crops on the farm.
Care of farm land, tools, and animals as directed by the supervisor.
requirements: Experience in farming or agriculture work preferred.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Physical fitness and willingness to work outdoors.

name: Heavy Driver
duties: Drive heavy vehicles such as trucks, dump trucks, and lorries safely.
Carry out daily vehicle checks and basic maintenance, and keep trip records.
requirements: Valid heavy vehicle driving license and proven driving experience.
Valid Passport with at least 3 years of validity.
Good knowledge of traffic rules and road safety.
